name: Reclaimed grey oak — real photogrammetry-scanned wood flooring material (4K web edition)
method: Photogrammetry scan of a physical wood surface, distributed by Poly Haven as Rough Wood (rough_wood). The 4K web edition maps are the library's own 4096 x 4096 scans, re-encoded once at high quality for web distribution — no procedural generation, no enlargement, no detail added. Tile coverage is an estimate from the scanned board layout. The complete native-resolution pack (including the ambient-occlusion map) and a 16K edition prepared from the original scan are planned for Google Drive hosting (links in the panel).
